# TURN 02 — Decision Delta

## New decisions
- W0–W4 work-risk taxonomy.
- S0–S3 source-risk taxonomy.
- Combined task/source routing.
- No Tier-A closure of W3/W4.
- Split literal detection from semantic binding for numerics, qualifiers, visuals, relationships, and state recovery.
- Residual census is not semantic completeness proof.

## Changed decisions
- LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH source risk replaced by a structured feature score.
- "Numeric sweep" decomposed into literal census vs parameter binding.
- "Qualifier sweep" decomposed into detection vs scope binding.
- "Visual review" decomposed into census/transcription vs semantic interpretation.

## Rejected ideas
- literal extraction is always low-risk.
- one universal scalar risk score.
- free-agent consensus can close contextual semantic work.

## New risks
- risk-router overconfidence.
- qualifier laundering.
- table semantic inversion.
- anaphora hallucination.

## New experiment
EXP-006 Hidden-Risk Task Challenge Set.

## Main open question
Which actual models earn each W1/W2/W3-assist role under a blind benchmark?
